description: This file defines an interface for node visitor classes used in Twig, a templating engine for PHP. It specifies methods for visiting nodes in a syntax tree.

classes.name: Twig\NodeVisitor\NodeVisitorInterface
classes.description: Interface for implementing node visitor classes in Twig, defining methods for entering and leaving nodes, and retrieving priority.

methods.name: enterNode
methods.description: Method called before child nodes are visited; takes a Node and Environment, returns a (possibly modified) Node.

methods.name: leaveNode
methods.description: Method called after child nodes are visited; takes a Node and Environment, returns a modified Node or null if removal is needed.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns an integer representing the visitor's priority level, typically between -10 and 10.
